text: Which of the following groups is NOT abelian?
choices: D₄, the symmetry group of the square
explanation: D₄ has eight elements (four rotations, four reflections), and a rotation followed by a reflection differs from the reflection followed by the rotation, so it is non-abelian. (ℤ,+), (ℤ/12ℤ,+), and (ℚ*,×) are all commutative and hence abelian.
